items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: We bought that pint of whiskey and old Pandssie, James P. M got so drunk he couldn't do nothing. Couldn't play the piano.

ctx.x: And he didn't drink a lot.
We bought that pint of whiskey and old Pandssie, James P. M got so drunk he couldn't do nothing. Couldn't play the piano. And Tommy got him so loaded because he was trying to out-drink me you know.
And they were out of practice eh?
